publications.title: The TTT Model: A Three-Step Approach to Tracing Professional Digital Competence in Teacher Education Coursework
publications.source_apa: I Beyond Technology: Human-AI Collaboration for Learning and Teaching (s. 182).
publications.abstract: Artikkelen introduserer TTT-modellen (Three-Step Approach to Tracing Professional Digital Competence), en tretrinns tilnærming for å kartlegge, spore og synliggjøre hvordan profesjonsfaglig digital kompetanse (PfDK) integreres og dokumenteres gjennom arbeidskrav i lærerutdanningen.

publications.title: When Everyone Is Responsible, No One Is: Organizational Barriers to Embedding Professional Digital Competence in Teacher Education
publications.source_apa: I Beyond Technology: Human-AI Collaboration for Learning and Teaching (s. 140).
publications.abstract: Undersøker de organisatoriske og strukturelle barrierene som oppstår når profesjonsfaglig digital kompetanse (PfDK) pålegges som et tverrfaglig ansvar i lærerutdanningen uten tydelig ansvarsfordeling og eierskap på program- og emnenivå.

publications.authors_apa: Andersland, I., Faye, R., & Norhagen, S. L.
publications.title: Placing religion virtually: combining textbooks with virtual student-produced 360-degree virtual tours of churches in teacher education for RE
publications.abstract: Denne studien undersøker hvordan lærebøker kombinert med studentproduserte 360-graders virtuelle ekskursjoner til kirkerom kan berike KRLE-undervisningen i lærerutdanningen gjennom sanselig tilstedeværelse, didaktisk design og felles faglig refleksjon.

publications.title: The PDC Ladder for Teacher Education: A Three-Tiered Framework for Digital Competence Integration
publications.source_apa: I Shaping the Future of Education in the Age of AI: Empowering Inclusion – EDEN Europe 2025 Annual Conference Proceedings (s. 218). EDEN Digital Learning Europe.
publications.abstract: This poster and paper introduce the PDC Ladder for Teacher Education, a visual and conceptual model that distinguishes digital competence at three interconnected levels: pupils, teachers, and teacher educators. Based on Starkey’s model for teachers’ Professional Digital Competence and extended through Uerz et al.’s emphasis on modeling and metacommunication, the framework supports a clearer understanding of the complex role teacher educators play in preparing future teachers for the digital age.

publications.authors_apa: Norhagen, S. L., Krumsvik, R. J., & Røkenes, F. M.
publications.title: Developing professional digital competence in Norwegian teacher education: A scoping review
publications.abstract: The widespread use of educational technology in schools compels teachers to seamlessly integrate technology while developing students’ digital competence. This scoping review investigates current research on Professional Digital Competence (PDC) and its implementation within Norwegian teacher education (2017–2022). Thirty-four peer-reviewed papers were identified and coded along three dimensions: (1) theoretical perspectives, (2) research questions and methods, and (3) application and implementation.

publications.title: FJORD Framework: Integrating Student Perspectives Through Holistic Course Design
publications.source_apa: I Learning in the Age of AI: Towards Imaginative Futures – EDEN Europe 2024 Proceedings (s. 179).
publications.abstract: The FJORD framework (Flexible, Journey-Oriented, Remote Design) emerges from Norway as a transformative approach to educational course design for online and blended higher education. Derived from international methodologies and merged with local educational needs, this contribution introduces the model, highlighting its adaptability, learner-centered approach, and digital integration.

publications.title: Hvordan støtte lesing på nettbrett – Trenger vi nye lesestrategier for digital lesing?
publications.abstract: Masteroppgave ved Høgskolen i Oslo og Akershus (nå OsloMet) som undersøker hvordan lesing på nettbrett skiller seg fra lesing på papir i skolen, og hvordan lærere kan støtte elevenes digitale leseforståelse og lesestrategier i multimodale og hypertekstuelle læringsomgivelser.
